Remarks

BuffTimed extends Buff to provide duration tracking and optional fade-out behavior. A duration less than or equal to zero means the buff does not expire automatically.

Remarks

Degrading buffs scale their effect by RemainingFraction, so they start at full strength and fade out.

1f - RemainingFraction
public float ElapsedFraction { get; }

Property Value

float

Remarks

This value starts at 0 when the buff begins and approaches 1 as the timer reaches zero. Use RemainingFraction when buff strength should fade out over time, and use ElapsedFraction when progress or charge-up behavior is needed.

RemainingFraction

The fraction of time remaining.
